title: Makeup Advance by Payment Plan — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Rule.** The makeup of a payment returned on a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term adds a percentage of the returned amount according to how the plan bills:

- **An installment plan billed directly** — no recurring payment authorization in force (signed authorizations not outnumbering revocations) and a number of installments above zero: 10 percent of the returned amount.
- **An installment plan that bills by automatic draft** — signed authorizations outnumbering revocations and a number of installments above zero: 5 percent.
- **The Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan** (number of installments zero), whatever its authorizations: nothing.

**Reading the plan.** Authorizations and revocations are counted from the plan's own authorization records; the number of installments is the plan's.

| Hypothetical plan | Authorizations / revocations | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan | 1 / 1 | 10 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 1 / 0 | 5 |
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 1 / 0 | none |
